tokens.name: jv_bg
tokens.usage: Ground for every screen: window, status bar and navigation bar. The darkest step; nothing sits below it.

tokens.name: jv_surface
tokens.usage: First raised step on jv_bg: list rows, settings panels, bottom nav, action bar, permission cards. Lists are square-cornered blocks of this fill separated by a 4–6dp gap of jv_bg.

tokens.name: jv_surface2
tokens.usage: Second step, used on jv_surface: secondary and compact button fills, model chips, the AI chat bubble, 1dp dividers between settings sections. As a divider on jv_surface it is 1.09:1, a tonal seam rather than a visible rule.

tokens.name: jv_accent
tokens.usage: Jarvis teal. The one brand hue: primary button fill, the user chat bubble, active pill outline, the idle dot, progress, focus, model chips' text, links like “Show output ▼”. As text it reads 13.5:1 on jv_bg, 11.4:1 on jv_surface2. Text on an accent fill is jv_on_accent (or jv_bg in chat bubbles), never white.

tokens.name: jv_violet
tokens.usage: Defined in colors.xml, used nowhere in the app. Reserved secondary hue. Fails as text: 2.9:1 on jv_bg; use only as a large fill or decoration if it is ever adopted.

tokens.name: jv_text
tokens.usage: Primary text on jv_bg, jv_surface and jv_surface2 (16.0 / 14.6 / 13.5:1). Titles, transcripts, AI chat text, values.

tokens.name: jv_text2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: status lines, helper copy, section labels, nav labels, hints, timestamps. 6.2:1 on jv_bg, 5.2:1 on jv_surface2.

tokens.name: jv_success
tokens.usage: Positive state: overlay running, vault folder set, “✓ Granted” button fill (with jv_bg text, 7.5:1). Always paired with a word or a ✓.

tokens.name: jv_warning
tokens.usage: Caution state: agent task running, context meter past 16k tokens, “Nothing to save.” 7.5:1 on jv_bg.

tokens.name: jv_error
tokens.usage: Failure state: task failed, overlay stopped, context meter past 28k tokens, error pill outline. 5.7:1 on jv_bg, 4.7:1 on jv_surface2.

tokens.name: jv_glass_border
tokens.usage: White at 14%: the 1dp hairline around glass pills, permission cards and text fields. Composites to about #2f3338 on jv_bg, only 1.5:1, below the 3:1 floor for control borders; inputs rely on their fill as well. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: jv_glass_bg
tokens.usage: jv_surface at 78% opacity: the fill of the floating overlay pill and the mode/talk pills, so the app or page behind shows through faintly.

tokens.name: jv_on_accent
tokens.usage: Text on a jv_accent fill (Get Started, Grant): 13.6:1. A literal in activity_onboarding.xml and the model managers, not yet a color resource.

tokens.name: jv_waveform
tokens.usage: Bar color of AudioWaveformView, the three recording bars in the overlay pill. A deeper cyan than jv_accent so recording reads distinct from idle. Literal in AudioWaveformView.kt.

tokens.name: jv_stop_ring
tokens.usage: Outline of the stop pill (pill_background_stop). 4.4:1 on jv_surface2. Literal in the drawable.

tokens.name: jv_stop_fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the stop pill, a dark green-black under the jv_stop_ring outline. Literal in the drawable.

tokens.name: jv_fab_stop
tokens.usage: Fill of the round stop FAB (fab_stop_bg). White glyphs on it reach only 4.2:1; keep them 24dp or larger. Literal in the drawable.

tokens.name: jv_disabled_fill
tokens.usage: Button tint while a model is downloading or unavailable in the model managers. jv_text2 on it is 4.1:1. Literal in ModelManagerActivity.kt.

tokens.name: jv_danger_fill
tokens.usage: Button tint for Delete in the model managers; jv_text on it is 11.9:1. Literal in ModelManagerActivity.kt.

tokens.name: jv_success_tint
tokens.usage: jv_success at 10%: fill of the granted permission icon tile (perm_icon_bg_green).

tokens.name: jv_success_tint_border
tokens.usage: jv_success at 40%: 1dp outline of the granted permission icon tile.

tokens.name: jv_dot_inactive
tokens.usage: jv_text2 at 35%: inactive onboarding step dots. About 1.8:1 on jv_bg, below 3:1; the active dot also differs in width (22dp vs 7dp), which carries the meaning.

tokens.name: pill_bg
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of jv_bg kept for older code. Use jv_bg in new work.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of jv_accent kept for older code. Use jv_accent in new work.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Legacy: icon vector fill (ic_mic, ic_settings) before tinting. Not a text color in the dark UI.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Legacy: white at 53%, from the first overlay design. Unused by current layouts.

styles.name: stat-lg
styles.usage: History header stats; value in jv_text, rate (wpm) in jv_accent.

styles.name: glyph
styles.usage: Bottom-nav emoji icons. Not for words.

styles.name: app-bar
styles.usage: Action bar title (JV.ActionBar.Title); also 18sp play/agent glyph buttons.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Setting row titles, onboarding subtitle; 16sp bold on the primary button.

styles.name: chat
styles.sample: Summarise today's notes into three bullets.
styles.usage: Chat bubbles, with 1.35 line spacing; 15sp bold for permission card titles and the talk button.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Jarvis needs these to show up when you need it.
styles.usage: Transcripts in history rows, overlay status, task names (bold), onboarding helper.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Buttons inside rows (Grant, Restart), streaming preview, raw transcript.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Setting descriptions, permission card subtitles, mode pills, task output preview.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The workhorse small size (52 uses): status lines, timestamps, compact buttons, helper text under fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section headers in Settings: uppercase, 0.08em tracking, jv_text2.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Bottom-nav labels, stat captions, model chips, token count (“0 tkns”).

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Dual-pass labels in history rows (WHISPER in jv_text2, ENHANCED in jv_accent): uppercase, 0.1em tracking.

styles.name: mono-input
styles.usage: Text fields that take tokens and URLs (HuggingFace token, model server URL).

spacing.note: dp in the app, px here. The source has no grid; these are the values the layouts actually use.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8
